title: Crypto Trading Signals - July 16, 2026
top_story_headline: JPMorgan completes tokenized equity conversion using Invesco's QQQ Trust with DTCC infrastructure, showcasing real-world tokenization within traditional capital markets
top_story_comment: DTCC’s March 3 FAQ makes the limitation explicit: the QQQ token moves 24/7 only free-of-value between DTC-registered wallets, receives no DTC collateral or end-of-day settlement value, and must return to book-entry form for traditional settlement. This is permissioned collateral plumbing, not DeFi composability; ComposerX LedgerScan remains the authoritative movement record, with DTC retaining clawback and force-transfer rights.
